blocks.content: When you start defining your own methods, there is a chance that you won't write code the right way (even though your program may work). We'll try to resolve that problem in this lesson.
When you think of methods, think of two things:

items: arguments - what values the methods might take
return value - what value the method will return

blocks.alt: Method with arguments and return value

blocks.content: With this in mind, we'll create these programs in this lesson:

items: Sum of natural numbers from 1 to n
The largest number among three numbers
